transcript:
Bot: Namaste, Rao Tiles se baat ho rahi hai?
Seller: Haan, Rao bol raha hoon.
Bot: IndiaMART se bol rahi hoon. Aapke tiles ke liye Hyderabad mein is mahine 84 BuyLeads aaye. Aap abhi enquiries kahan se le rahe hain?
Seller: Mostly references. Online zyada nahi kiya.
Bot: Samjhi. Aapke average order 60,000 ke aas paas hote hain?
Seller: Haan, lagbhag.
Bot: Toh har hafte 17-21 verified requirements aayein toh kaafi scope hai. Do minute hain, ek number batati hoon?
Seller: Haan batao.
Bot: Har mahine 1,900 buyers aapki category dekh rahe hain, 11 crore ka business. Dus mein se ek close ho toh 4 lakh mahine ka extra. Ek meeting rakhein?
Seller: Haan, Thursday shaam ko.
